ref_atoms.ref_content: KMAC smoke test runs a full hashing operation: randomize interrupts, mode, key length, endianness; set function name 'KMAC', customization empty; set output length; select entropy source; during absorption, read from STATE window expect 0; write message (max 32 bytes); check status and kmac_done, status.squeeze set; read digest and compare with C model (XOR shares for masked, share2=0 for unmasked); issue cmd.done to clear state, read digest again confirm 0; DPI-C and scoreboard check correctness.
Same as smoke but with message up to 100KB and output length up to 1KB for XOF; manually run keccak rounds to squeeze extra output; randomize function name 'KMAC' and customization string.
Burst-write chunks of the message into msg_fifo, disable intermediate status/CSR checks, similar to long_message test.
Drive NIST test vectors for SHA3/SHAKE/KMAC; check output digest against expected values.
Set cfg.sideload and provide a valid sideloaded key along with a valid SW-provided key; KMAC should operate on the sideloaded key regardless of cfg_shadowed.sideload field value.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Points to cfg.sideload and cfg_shadowed.sideload registers and describes hardware behavior of using sideloaded key regardless of shadowed field.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Keymgr/ROM/LC initiate KMAC operation via application interface; use kmac_app_agents to send message and control hashing; set cfg.sideload if Keymgr enabled; compare digest with DPI model; read from STATE window afterwards, confirm access blocked and returns 0.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks STATE window access blocked returning 0 after app operation, a specific hardware mechanism.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Based on app test, send partial data via application interface with strb values other than 8'hFF; will not check status and intr_state registers but will check other registers and interface digest; scoreboard not cycle-accurate for this.

Test entropy interface: randomly select SW or App hash; request EDN entropy via cmd.entropy_req, cmd.hash_cnt_clear, and entropy_refresh_threshold_shadowed; in masked mode check entropy_refresh_hash_cnt value and EDN request timing; in unmasked mode check entropy_refresh_hash_cnt always 0.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Tests entropy_refresh_hash_cnt register behavior and EDN request timing with masked/unmasked modes.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Try several error sequences: update key/prefix/config during absorption/process/squeeze; write msg to msg_fifo during process/squeeze; in KMAC mode, set function name not 'KMAC'; incorrect SHA3 control flow (e.g., Process before Start, Run before Process); incorrect KMAC configurations; provide SW inputs during app operation.

Test KMAC response when Keymgr app sends request but key not valid: configure KMAC, send keymgr request without setting valid bit; wait, issue err_processed, wait for handshake finish; repeat. Check err_code, status, interrupt; check keymgr interface response with all-zero digests and error bit set; check KMAC resumes normal operation afterwards.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks err_code, status, interrupt registers and keymgr interface error bit for key not valid scenario.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Invalidate sideloaded key by forcing .valid signal to 0 during random app state; check err_code; check keymgr interface response with all-zero digests and error bit set; check KMAC resumes normal operation.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks err_code and keymgr interface response when sideloaded key valid signal forced to 0.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Configure EDN timeout error by writing entropy_period.wait_timer and entropy_period.prescaler; check err_code, status, interrupt; check keymgr interface error bit set; check KMAC resumes; timeout not triggered if entropy_mode is SW or masking disabled.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks EDN timeout error registers and conditions: entropy_period registers, err_code, status, interrupt, and interaction with entropy_mode/masking.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Write incorrect ral.cfg_shadowed.entropy_mode before entropy fetch; check err_code, status, interrupt; check keymgr interface error bit set; check KMAC resumes; timeout not triggered if masking disabled.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks err_code, status, interrupt and keymgr interface for incorrect entropy_mode configuration.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Do not write 1 to ral.cfg_shadowed.entropy_ready before KMAC operation; if masking enabled and EDN mode: for SW operation check err_code, status, interrupt; for APP operation check keymgr interface error bit; if masking disabled or no entropy required, no error.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks err_code, status, interrupt or keymgr interface based on entropy_ready setting and masking/EDN mode.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Set lc_escalate_en to non-Off during KMAC operations; check fatal alert fires continuously until reset; status.alert_fatal_fault set to 1, sha3_idle reset to 0; KMAC does not accept any SW or APP requests; Digest window always outputs 0.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks fatal alert, alert_fatal_fault, sha3_idle, and digest window behavior when lc_escalate_en is active.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Combine above sequences in one test sequentially (except csr sequence and some error tests that disabled scoreboard), with random reset between sequences.
Measure throughput of various hashing calculations and ensure they correspond to expected throughput range.
Cover all valid configuration settings: hashing mode (sha3/shake/kmac), security strength, key length, message/digest endianness, XOF mode when KMAC; crossing all valid combinations.
Cover various input message length ranges from 0 bytes to 10,000 bytes, including corner cases (length 0).
Cover various output digest lengths for XOF functions to ensure KMAC can produce outputs of varying sizes.
Cover that prefix values (function_name + customization_string) consist of valid alphabet letters or space.
Cover that msgfifo has been written using all possible TLUL masks.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Covers msgfifo write behavior with all TLUL masks, a specific hardware interface feature.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Cover all possible fifo statuses during different hash operations: various depths, fifo full, fifo empty.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Covers msgfifo statuses (full, empty, depth) during different hash operations, a specific hardware buffer state.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Cover that all sha3-related status fields have eventually been seen.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Covers all sha3-related status fields, specific hardware status signals.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Cover that state windows have been read using all possible TLUL masks.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Covers state window read behavior with all TLUL masks, a specific hardware access feature.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Cover that KMAC handles CmdProcess command during various msgfifo status (full/empty/in between) and while keccak rounds are active/inactive.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Covers CmdProcess command handling under specific msgfifo status and keccak round states, a specific hardware control flow.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Cover scenarios where sideloaded key is provided and should be used (en_sideload==1, app_mode==AppKeymgr) and where sideloaded key is provided but should not be used.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Covers sideloaded key usage conditions with en_sideload and app_mode, a specific hardware configuration.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Cover app interface scenarios: single data beat, all partial data lengths (last beat), errors reported through interface, Done signal while keccak rounds active/inactive.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Covers app interface scenarios with Done signal and keccak rounds, specific hardware control and error reporting.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Cover app interface and cfg_shadowed register: hash_mode, kmac_en, kstrength; SW register settings should not affect app interface calculation.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Covers cfg_shadowed register fields effect on app interface, a specific hardware configuration interaction.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Cover values for entropy_period register's prescaler and wait_timer fields, crossed with EDN mode on/off.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Covers entropy_period register prescaler/wait_timer and EDN mode, a specific hardware timer configuration.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Cover all error scenarios: ErrKeyNotValid, ErrSwPushedMsgFifo, ErrSwIssuedCmdInAppActive, ErrWaitTimerExpired, ErrIncorrectEntropyMode, ErrUnexpectedModeStrength, ErrIncorrectFunctionName, ErrSwCmdSequence.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Covers specific error codes generated by hardware under defined conditions.
